workflow: Synthetic API and Chromium tests of conversational entry, clinical workflows and progressive member panel

checks: six recovered diagrams load, zoom, close and expose PNG/SVG files
feedback whitespace validation, local draft reload, generated text, download and stale-output invalidation
feedback works when browser storage is blocked
keyboard skip link and concise guide

features: Focused welcome without sidebar or empty dashboard metrics
Six visit reasons, multiple concerns with one primary, persisted contextual questions
User-selected goals including clinician-assisted choice; no inferred diagnosis or health score
Profile conversation and preserved mandatory safety/history questions
Calm state-driven home; program navigation appears after actual publication
Member-initiated followup keeps prior plan, rechecks safety and permits same-record resubmission without another payment
Finite motion with reduced-motion support and responsive 320–1440px layout
Complete target flowchart viewer included in showcase and archive with target labeling
limitations: Real Android/iPhone camera and GPS not tested
Home visits remain demo-only; production provider/retention agreements not implemented
City starter catalog is not a nationwide official dataset
Public site uses browser-local storage; no shared cross-device patient database
SMS, banking, provider appointment confirmation and live medical operation remain unconnected
Startup improvement verified with controlled delays, not measured on user network
Safari and Firefox not tested; no comprehensive security/load audit or clinical validation
Goals are reason-based conversation prompts, not validated disease-specific care targets
Target diagram includes future integrations and operational decisions; implemented scope is documented in JOURNEY-v2.0-fa.md

publicBrowser.reason: Chromium does not trust the environment proxy CA; automatic approval review rejected a persistent trust-store addition. TLS verification was not disabled. Public HTTPS byte comparison succeeded; browser behavior was tested locally.
